method: Own comment-stripped retail review performed with candidate source names/mappings hidden; observations saved before reveal. Then original demo counterpart reviewed and the identical Windows-demo/retail code bridge rechecked. This is not an owner sign-off or a third-party review.

rows.name: desInit3DEngine_
rows.blind_observation: Engine teardown: frees the buffer at 0x5e546c and prints desinit 3Dengine.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: SYM_InitSymboleInObjet_
rows.blind_observation: Builds a path from a fixed prefix and filename, opens and appends file bytes to the cursor at 0x630844; saves start in actor+0xf8 and sets actor+0xa9 bit 0x10. File prefix needs checking before assigning a format-specific meaning. Binary prefix is data\sym\, confirming script/symbol-file loading.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: PutScreenInfo_
rows.blind_observation: Displays actor mana/life gauges for positive values above the encoded threshold; displays oxygen only under the global gate and movement mode 2. Calls three independently named gauge drawers.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: Remap256to16bits_
rows.blind_observation: Only a wrapper around 0x454de3. The wrapper alone does not identify subsystem or action; inspect its callee. Follow-up before reveal: callee 0x454de3 converts lookup-indexed frame pixels into display pixels for several screen modes and clears letterbox regions. Thus this wrapper presents/converts a decoded video frame, not teardown.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: PAR_InitParticlesCreate_
rows.blind_observation: Writes two 3-vectors as rounded values times 256 minus/plus 25600. Looks like fixed-point min/max bounds; input origin is obscured by the float-helper prototype and needs instruction review. Follow-up before reveal: instruction trace reads doubles at input EAX+0/+8/+16, converts to integer and builds XYZ min/max bounds around that input point. No world-space assertion.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: MAP_InsertMapAnimParticle_
rows.blind_observation: Finds material SPRITE and updates the matching one of 64 animated-material records (stride 0x420), refreshes material pointers and sets flag 8; returns success/failure.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: ELE_CompLifeDestination_
rows.blind_observation: Generates three random coordinate components and offsets them by coordinates at +0xc/+0x10/+0x14 of the block referenced by 0x5e23b8. Writes float XYZ at destination+4/+8/+0xc. Range operands require assembly if changing behavior.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: WEA_ChockObjet2_
rows.blind_observation: Gated by target flag +0xaf bit 0x20, emits eight hit particles then applies a mass-scaled, clamped blend of incoming direction into target velocity. Special action 0x2b affects scale; vertical velocity is reset to zero. Horizontal knockback/ejection role.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: CopyRandParticle_
rows.blind_observation: If emitter+0x2c has a target particle, copies position, adds random velocity jitter, randomizes life and invokes progressively more initializers for modes 1/2/3. Particle initialization/reset role.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: clonePLayer_
rows.blind_observation: Finds a free actor among slots 2..31, initializes and flags it, duplicates the source model, copies animation/action state and position with X/Z offsets, and positions the duplicate node. Returns new actor or null. Actor clone role; specific gameplay use unproven.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.

rows.name: SYM_PrintTextReceive_
rows.blind_observation: Renders an actor-associated choice/menu record selected by actor+0xfc, stride 0x7d8. Draws selected/unselected choices and extra actions, scrolls text to x=40, then resets an animation phase. Appears paired with the script-file loader; exact menu labels to check. The extra literal labels are Back and End; actor-associated symbol/dialogue menu rendering.
rows.source_counterpart_review: Confirmed against original demo decompilation after recording the blind retail review. Source and target layout/prototype equivalence is not inferred.
